text:
(2) The Secretary of State must consult—
(a) the Advisory Council, or
(b) if the order is to be made under section 2A(1) and the urgency condition
applies, the person mentioned in subsection (3).

(3) The person referred to in subsection (2)(b) is—
(a) the person who is for the time being the chairman of the Advisory Council
appointed under paragraph 1(3) of Schedule 1, or
(b) if that person has delegated the function of responding to consultation under
subsection (1)(a) to another member of the Advisory Council, that other
member.

(4) The “urgency condition” applies if it appears to the Secretary of State that the misuse
of the substance or product to be specified in the order as a drug subject to temporary
control, or the likelihood of its misuse, poses an urgent and significant threat to public
safety or health.
